# jumpcloud_user_group (Resource)

Manages a JumpCloud user group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jumpcloud_user_group" "example" {
  name              = "Engineering"
  description       = "Engineering team members"
  membership_method = "STATIC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the user group.
- `membership_method` (String) Membership method: STATIC, DYNAMIC_REVIEW_REQUIRED, or DYNAMIC_AUTOMATED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the user group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import jumpcloud_user_group.example <group-id>
```
